question_options.question: How would you rate this pack?
Who do you like better, Justin or Erik?
Do you think Justin and Angie should date?

nodes.text: High above the bushes, Alexei looks down at Justin and Erik.

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: Grrr...
He is soon joined by the rest of the Wilson High elites... Justin and Erik stand and face them...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: What are you gonna do now, Wilson High?! Can't get your cars down here, can you?!
Alexei tries to come down to them, but he gets pricked by a bush.

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: `Ow!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Ow![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Awww...Afraid of a couple of little thorns? That's what I thought!
Justin holds up his phone...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: That's right! I'm about to warn everyone about your dumb catapult! It's over... Punks!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Uh... Justin?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Not now, Erik.
Justin tries to call Angie from his phone, but it doesn't work...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: It's not working...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Yeah, it's soaked, Justin.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: But... Technology?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Still not completely waterproof.

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: Heh heh heh! You're not out of the woods yet, dweebs!

nodes.speaker: Steve
nodes.text: And he means that literally! 'Cause you `are` currently in the woods! Am I right? Am I right?
nodes.text_bbcode: And he means that literally! 'Cause you [color=#e23b3b][i]are[/i][/color] currently in the woods! Am I right? Am I right?

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: Steve?! Come on! You're really killing the mood!

nodes.speaker: Steve
nodes.text: Sorry...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Let's go! They're going to figure out a way around those thorny bushes soon!
Justin and Erik turn and flee into the woods... The shouts of the Wilson High elites calling after them...
Justin has failed! Try again and see if you can help Justin escape Wilson's clutches!
You have earned %d out of 100 Points for this chapter.

nodes.prompt: What do you want to do?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: What do you want to do?

nodes.text: Justin lifts on the handlebars, propelling him, Erik, and the bike high into the air, over a thicket of bushes...
And right into a flowing river!
`KERSPLOOSH!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [b]KERSPLOOSH![/b]

nodes.text: Both of them paddle to the other edge of the river and climb out on the other side...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: You okay?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Yeah, I'm fine...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Hot dog! I think we dodged a bullet!
Erik points at the bushes they just cleared, which are all covered with thorns!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I'm really glad we hit that jump now!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: No!
Justin veers away from the ramp at the last second...
But it's too late for him to stop! The guys reach the top of the ravine!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Uh oh!
Down they tumble, rolling through a thicket of thorny bushes!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: `Ow! Ow! Ow!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Ow! Ow! Ow![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: `Yoooooooow!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Yoooooooow![/i][/color]

nodes.text: The last of their momentum carries them into a river!
`Splunk!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [b]Splunk![/b]

nodes.text: Both of them paddle to the other edge of the river and climb out on the other side...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Why didn't you jump the ramp?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I didn't know the other option was tumbling through thorny bushes, okay?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: At least it would have been adventurous...
Justin hesitates! He nears the ramp...
...And hesitates!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Wait... But what about the apology to Principal Dunkirk?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I think we've veered a little bit past the apology stage, don't you?!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Touche, sir.
Erik hurls the pieces at the ground. They ricochet up, bouncing into the underbelly of Skazz's car!
`SH-SHUNK! SHUNK! SHUNK! SHUNK!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [b]SH-SHUNK! SHUNK! SHUNK! SHUNK![/b]

nodes.speaker: Steve
nodes.text: What the...?!

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: My car!
Skazz's car spins out, slamming into a fire hydrant!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Check aaaaaand mate!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: We're finally out of hot water!
That's when Alexei's car comes skidding around the far corner!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Uh oh!

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: Grr!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Turn around and pedal! Pedal! Pedal!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: What do you think I'm doing?!
Justin pedals as fast as he can in the opposite direction of Alexei's car! Alexei floors it, coming up on Justin and Erik at breakneck speed!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: We're never gonna make it! What do we do?
In a bend in the road ahead, Justin sees a natural ramp formed by fallen trees!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: There! We have to jump!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: This is crazy! We don't know where the ramp goes!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Do it anyway!
Alexei's car is nearly upon them! Just as they reach the bend, Justin aims for the ramp, and he...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: How is the chess set going to help us?
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Just try to get the pieces bouncing on the street under his car! If you do it right, you might be able to cause some damage!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Roger roger! That's a go!
Erik grabs a fistful of chess pieces...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Do you have a better idea?!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: How about the chess set?!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: That is... Actually a much better idea...
Erik grabs a fistful of chess pieces...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Olive oil? Are we planning on making Skazz some pasta?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Do you have a better idea?!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: How about the chess set?!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: That is... Actually a much better idea...
Erik grabs a fistful of chess pieces...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Glowsticks? Do we want to guide him `to` us?
nodes.text_bbcode: Glowsticks? Do we want to guide him [color=#e23b3b][i]to[/i][/color] us?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Do you have a better idea?!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: How about the chess set?!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: That is... Actually a much better idea...
Erik grabs a fistful of chess pieces...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I hate to break it to you, Justin, but Skazz isn't that dumb! He knows it's us on this bike!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Plus, neither of us have the complexion to pull off that look in the summer...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Do you have a better idea?!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: How about the chess set?!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: That is... Actually a much better idea...
Erik grabs a fistful of chess pieces...
Skazz's car revs forward, still on their tail!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Bananas!
Steve aims his gun out the window and fires another round of paintball pellets...
Justin cringes, but all he hears is `WAP! WAP! WAP!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Justin cringes, but all he hears is [b]WAP! WAP! WAP![/b]

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Erik? How am I not hit? Are you okay?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Keen as a peach! I used the gift bag as a shield!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: The gift bag! Brilliant! We could probably mess up Skazz's car with the...

nodes.prompt: Which item from the gift bag?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: Which item from the gift bag?

nodes.text: Justin reaches out to catch Erik, but Erik's fingers slip through his hands!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Whoops!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: `Ack!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Ack![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Erik falls, his shirt catching on the spokes of Justin's back tire! His feet pump fast along the concrete!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Fast feet! Fast feet!
With a final, Herculean effort, Erik manages to leap onto the back of Justin's bike!
Meanwhile...
Erik's unmanned bike flips over, wedging itself under Darren's car, producing a horrific tearing sound!

nodes.speaker: Darren
nodes.text: Crap! My car!
Darren stops his car completely!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: You okay, Erik?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Yeah... My toes are so hot and tender now... They're like little fire-roasted wieners!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I thought you were gonna catch me!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I'm sorry...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Wait... What's that sound?
From behind them, they hear a loud whirring sound...
Justin grabs Erik! The bike wobbles...
But Justin steadies it!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I gotcha!
Unmanned, Erik's bike flips over, wedging itself under Darren's car, producing a horrific tearing sound!

nodes.speaker: Darren
nodes.text: Crap! My car!
Darren stops his car completely!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Ha ha ha! Way to go, Bike!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I hardly knew ye...
Justin reaches out to catch Erik, but Erik's fingers slip through his hands!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Whoops!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: `Ack!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Ack![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Erik falls, his shirt catching on the spokes of Justin's back tire! His feet pump fast along the concrete!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Fast feet! Fast feet!
With a final, Herculean effort, Erik manages to leap onto the back of Justin's bike!
Meanwhile...
Erik's unmanned bike flips over, wedging itself under Darren's car, producing a horrific tearing sound!

nodes.speaker: Darren
nodes.text: Crap! My car!
Darren stops his car completely!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: You okay, Erik?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Yeah... My toes are so hot and tender now... They're like little fire-roasted wieners!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I thought you were gonna catch me!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I'm sorry...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Wait... What's that sound?
From behind them, they hear a loud whirring sound...
Justin throws his hand up in the air!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I yield! I yield!
He stops his bike, and the Wilson cars surround him and Erik...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: What's the plan here? I don't see the angle, buddy!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: All we can do now is appeal to their sense of honor and mercy.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: But... But it's Wilson High...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I know...
The Wilson elites step out of their cars, lining up in a row in front of Justin and Erik, paintball guns at the ready...

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: Any last words?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: We aren't here to cause any problems. Actually, believe it or not, we're here on a mission of peace.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: With a gift bag fit for a really weird king...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Anyway, whatever you were doing with the big paint catapult thing... That's cool... We don't care. We just want to find your principal and give him this...
Darren lunges forward and snatches the gift bag out of Justin's hand!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: And we know, in your heart of hearts, that you're going to do the right thing.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Which, FYI, is letting us go!
Justin nudges Erik.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Sorry, it's Wilson! I don't know if they know what the right thing is...

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: Shut up! Both of you!

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: We're calling the shots here! The way I see it, after what you guys did at our graduation ceremony, we're at war!

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: And that makes the two of you casualties of our war...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Casualties? But casualties are usually wounded or...
Alexei laughs, raising his paintball gun. The other Wilson elites follow suit.

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: I'd say 'sorry', but that would be the complete opposite of what I feel.

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: `Fire!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Fire![/i][/color]

nodes.text: The Wilson elites fire their paintball guns, peppering Justin and Erik until both of them look like a pair of over-sized tie-dyed shirts...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Ow. Just `ow` everywhere.
nodes.text_bbcode: Ow. Just [color=#e23b3b][i]ow[/i][/color] everywhere.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Ditto.
One thing is as glaringly apparent as the fluorescent paint dripping off of him...
Score Up!
Justin slams on the brakes just as both girls fire their guns!
Their paintballs splatter all over each other's clothes, cars, and faces!

nodes.speaker: Stiletto
nodes.text: My car! My perfect car!

nodes.speaker: Elliana
nodes.text: My face! My perfect face!
Meanwhile, Justin turns down a side street, and Erik rides up behind him...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Nice steering, buddy!
But Darren and Skazz's cars hug the turn and accelerate right behind Erik!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: `AHH!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]AHH![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Darren
nodes.text: What are you riding away for?!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I'm not going to make it! I'm not going to make it!

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: We just want to be friends!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Hiccup! Hiccup! Hiccup!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Keep pedaling, Erik!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Cars always beat bikes, Justin! I'm statistically done for!
Steve leans out the window of Skazz's car and fires a round of paintballs at Erik's back!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Ow! Ow! Ow!

nodes.speaker: Steve
nodes.text: Heh. New favorite sport! Nerd hunting!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Leave him alone, you butt ugly jerk!
Steve fires another pellet, this one causing Erik's tire to explode!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Whooooooa! Wobbly time!
Darren's car comes forward, this time rubbing the exposed frame of Erik's back wheel! Sparks fly everywhere!

nodes.speaker: Darren
nodes.text: Ha! Check it out! Fireworks!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: You son of a...
Justin slows down so that he's right in front of Erik's bike!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Erik, jump!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I don't think so!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: You have to jump!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I'm pretty sure I could also `not` jump!
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm pretty sure I could also [color=#e23b3b][i]not[/i][/color] jump!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I'll catch you!
Another blast of sparks shoots off of Erik's back wheel!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: On second thought...
Erik leaps from his bike!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Woooop!
Justin pedals with all his energy, his feet like pistons of continuous energy!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Grr!
Soon there's separation between his bike and Darren's car!

nodes.speaker: Darren
nodes.text: Hey!
Erik appears on Justin's right side, pedaling just as hard!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Justin! I'm not cut out for this kind of sweaty adventure! I think we're going to have to...
But Stiletto's car knifes between them, separating Justin and Erik!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Whoa!

nodes.speaker: Stiletto
nodes.text: Sorry to interrupt the party!
Stiletto banks her car left toward Justin! He veers left...
And almost crashes into Elliana's car!

nodes.speaker: Elliana
nodes.text: Don't you dare scratch me, American nerd!
Both cars are parallel to Justin, closing the space between each other, sandwiching him!
Stiletto smiles as she pulls out a paintball gun and points it at Justin!

nodes.speaker: Stiletto
nodes.text: Night, night.
Elliana whips out a gun of her own, aiming it out her passenger side window!

nodes.speaker: Elliana
nodes.text: Sweet dreams!
The wind rips through Justin's hair as he pedals furiously!
Darren accelerates a little more...
His front bumper scrapes Justin's back tire!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: `Aah!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Aah![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Darren
nodes.text: Heh heh!
Justin pedals hard, his bicycle humming across the concrete!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Why?! Am I?! On a bicycle?!
Darren positions his car right behind Justin and sticks his head out the window...

nodes.speaker: Darren
nodes.text: Hey, dummy! Why are you breathing so hard?!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: You know what else I'm excited about?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: The 4th of July Bonfire over at Centerscore Beach!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: No thanks, I'll pass...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Awww, it's the best! Everything that makes the 4th of July great! Plus, everyone's going to be there tonight!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Exactly, everyone being there will remind me that I don't really have any friends...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: That's crazy talk! Of course you have friends, Justin! You've got me, and the guys, and Angie...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Yeah, well, I don't play Ogres 'N' Elves, and Angie and I can't exactly be friends...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: You mean... Because she's an Elf?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Something like that...
As Justin and Erik get closer to Wilson High, Justin pulls out his smart phone.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I have an app that will tell me exactly where Dunkirk's office is, so we don't have to waste any time...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I think we just turn left up here...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Well, this app says we go farther before we turn left, so that's what we're going to do.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Okay... Sure...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: You're the boss!
When they reach the farther junction, Justin and Erik turn left...
And pull into a lot in the back of Wilson High...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I'm not sure I'm using this app right, 'cause now it says we need to turn around...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Oh, my sweet Betsy! Justin, look!
Justin looks up from his phone... And immediately pedals his bike behind a nearby car, Erik right behind him!
In front of them, Wilson High students are scrambling about, barking orders to each other, and wildly driving in circles around an enormous vehicle!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: What is that?!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: It's a catapult!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: What are they loading into it? Those look like... Like humongous balls of paint!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Holy Neptune! It's a Splat-A-Pult!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Come on, Justin! We've got to skedaddle before someone sees us!
Nearby, Steve runs up to Alexei!

nodes.speaker: Steve
nodes.text: Everything's loaded up!

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: Took you long enough! Let's ride. Those dweebs at Centerscore aren't going to know what hit 'em!

nodes.speaker: Steve
nodes.text: Ha ha! They'll probably know it was paint!

nodes.speaker: Steve
nodes.text: Plus, remember, they're called Twin Branches now!

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: Steve... Just... Shut up.

nodes.speaker: Steve
nodes.text: Sorry...
Justin's phone beeps! Alexei and Steve whirl around!

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: Spies!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Come on, really? Of all the times for my mom to send me a text...

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: I should have known you Centersc... I mean... Twin Branches dweebs would do something stupid like this!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Ride, Erik, ride!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: You don't have to tell me twice!

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: `Get them!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Get them![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Justin and Erik pedal furiously out of the lot!
Several Wilson cars peel out behind them, slamming onto the street right behind Justin and Erik!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Cripes!
Justin pedals furiously, stealing glances back over his shoulder...
From the pack of cars, Darren's surges out, the engine roaring!
Justin imitates Erik...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Hey, did you know Paul Revere invented goat cheese? Did you know Paul Revere ran three marathons in one day?! Did you know Paul Revere was the first man to give birth?!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I get it, okay? Paul Revere was awesome. Now please give it a rest!
Erik wipes at his eyes...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: At least... At least I'm patriotic...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: What is that supposed to mean?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: If we're the Americans right now, then you're just a traitorous Benedict Arnold! You're the school President, and you're not even excited to be representing Twin Branches!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I'll just be excited to be done with this task, Erik.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Well, that's not the right attitude. I think you should always be excited for the adventure along the way!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: ...And I get an itchy feeling we're about to have one!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: But I might be confusing it with this rash on my arm...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I guess I do get carried away some times... Okay, last one!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Did you know that Paul Revere probably didn't even shout 'The British are coming!'?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Wait... He didn't?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Nope! The whole point of him warning the colonials was secrecy!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Oh, that makes sense...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Besides, a lot of those colonials still considered themselves to be British!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: It'd be like us at school yelling, 'The Squirrels are coming! The Squirrels are coming!'

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: It wouldn't make sense! Everyone would be like, 'What? `We're` coming?'
nodes.text_bbcode: It wouldn't make sense! Everyone would be like, 'What? [color=#e23b3b][i]We're[/i][/color] coming?'

nodes.text: Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Huh! Good fact, Erik.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Thanks!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I admit I was apprehensive about going over to Wilson with you, but you're good people.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: And I'm just excited to be your number two!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Uhhhh... I lost my train of thought...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: You know who probably `never` lost his train of thought?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Don't say it...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Paul Revere!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Ugggggh!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: He was a thinker, a hero, a man, a legend... And a dentist! I think I mentioned the dentist thing, but it's worth mentioning twice!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: If he had kept his dentist practice going, I bet he would have started the Boston `Teeth` Party!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Ugh... I didn't know it was possible for a joke to make you physically ill...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I'm really excited to share all my Paul Revere facts with you, Justin!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: This just... This just isn't the way I wanted to leave my office. I wanted to leave behind some kind of legacy.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I imagined my programs being hated at first... Programs like Studying Through Sickness, Algebra Homework Hour, and the Removal of Football Initiative!

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: Wow... Just... Wow.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: But I also imagined the students growing to love those programs! I imagined them growing to love the President who implemented them!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I imagined them looking back on my era with a wide smile...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: But, Principal, delivering a gift bag to our rival is something people will look back on with an irritated grimace at best!

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: You might be surprised, Justin. Simple things can have great power.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Yeah, sure...
Justin takes the letter and the gift bag and mopes his way toward the door...

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: Oh, and one more thing...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Yes?

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: As a precaution, I never send any of my students over to the Wilson side of town alone, so you'll be going there with a friend...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: That's funny, because I don't really have any...
The door swings open!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Howdy, pal o' pals! Ready to get this adventure ball rolling?!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Oh no...
A few minutes later, Justin and Erik are biking their way over to Wilson High...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Remind me again how you talked me into riding our bikes instead of taking my car.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Easy! You fell prey to the plucky, persuasive Ericson charm! Patent pending!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: We're about to go to Wilson High with our tails between our legs... How are you this upbeat?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: It's my favorite holiday, the 4th of July! The time of fireworks, BBQ hot dogs, and best of all... Patriotism!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Oh no, I totally forgot you're in love with Paul Revere...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: You know, I was just thinking how much we're like the Americans of the Revolution right now!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I imagine that we're riding horses on the way to our British oppressors and telling them, 'No! We will not suffer any more of your monarchical tyranny!'

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: This situation is not even a little bit like the Revolution...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: We're on bicycles, not horses. We're not oppressed by Wilson High. And we're not confronting them right now, we're apologizing!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: It's at least sort of similar. I mean, we don't like them.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: We're giving them a `gift bag,` Erik! Could you imagine George Washington offering up King George a bag of... Of...
nodes.text_bbcode: We're giving them a [color=#e23b3b][i]gift bag,[/i][/color] Erik! Could you imagine George Washington offering up King George a bag of... Of...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Wait... What's in here, anyway?
Justin pulls his bike over to the side of the street and opens up the gift bag. He pulls out an assortment of items...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: A travel chess set, some olive oil, glowsticks, and some white makeup?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: This is the most random gift bag ever!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I'm pretty sure King George would have liked it... Especially the glowsticks!
Justin sighs and resumes pedaling...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Hey, did you know that Paul Revere had 11 brothers and sisters?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: No, I did not know that, Erik...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: He did! It would have been such a hoot in their house!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: But I bet it got awfully chippy during bath time.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Uh huh...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Did you know Paul Revere took up dentistry for a while?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: No, Erik, I didn't...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: He did! If Paul Revere gave me a cleaning, I know exactly what I would have told him...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: One if bicuspid, tooth if by sea!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: That's... An alarmingly bad joke.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Hey, did you know...?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Erik, please, with the Paul Revere facts...

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: Excuse me?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I hate Wilson High! So does everyone at this school! Offering them an apology is pretty much dead last on my list of summer funtivities!

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: I appreciate your honesty, Justin. I've always known you had a lot of character, and it's nice to see how much you've changed.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Well, thanks, I guess.

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: But lame or not, I still need you to do this for me...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Yes, ma'am...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: It's really... Great...
Shapiro raises her eyebrow again.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Wow... I suck at lying.

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: I thought we had reached a point where you could be honest with me, Justin. I guess I was wrong.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I'm sorry...
Justin rides faster than he's ever ridden before...
Score Up!
Through the Wilson side of town...
Past Monarch Prep...
Into the Centerscore side of town...
Past the Twin Branches campus...
Until finally, he arrives at the beach...

nodes.text: Justin rides toward the Centerscore side of town, but he's quickly distracted...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I wonder if Angie will like me when I save Twin Branches...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Maybe she'll think I'm a hero...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Maybe she'll kiss me, dump $Scott, and we'll be together!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Yeah, right, who am I kidding? There is no Angie and I... And there never will be...
Finally, Justin arrives at the beach...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I can't believe how much time I wasted by being so distracted by Angie!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Well, great! I'll just stop wasting my time then and go try to save your friends on my own!
Justin starts to march out!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Wait... You're jealous, aren't you?
Justin stops in the doorway and turns around.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: You think I'm jealous of you?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: A little bit... I mean, there's no reason you can't warn everyone on your own... You don't really need me.
Justin sighs...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Yeah, okay, maybe I am a little bit jealous.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: There's someone I have feelings for, but I can't act on them, I can't tell her...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: And maybe I see you having a good time, and that hurts... Because I can't do that.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Just tell her, buddy.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: It's not that simple, Erik.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Sure it is. Just say what you're feeling. It might be hard to do because it's scary... But it really is that simple.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Whatever...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I just find it ironic that you're so into patriotism and the 4th of July, but when it comes to helping out your friends, `your school,` you'd rather make out with some girl instead.
nodes.text_bbcode: I just find it ironic that you're so into patriotism and the 4th of July, but when it comes to helping out your friends, [color=#e23b3b][i]your school,[/i][/color] you'd rather make out with some girl instead.

nodes.text: Justin storms out of the cabin...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Where are you going?

nodes.speaker: Madisenn
nodes.text: The party's just starting!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: The party's over...
Justin runs with his bike out of the forest...
And onto the streets near Wilson High...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Erik might not be with me, but I still have a job to do. I need to warn everyone!
He gets onto his bicycle and starts pedaling...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: And that means getting to the beach on the other side of town as fast as possible!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: The moment?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Yeah, think about it. Wilson showing up here, all that stress, all that tension...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: And the two of you survived it together!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: But...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Plus, you were playing the hero... Or, I guess, the heroine in this case.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I concede you might have a point here...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: You know I'm right.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Maybe you are...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: But I'm still staying! Final answer!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: That's where you're wrong, Justin!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: She and I dated before, and if she has any kind of type, it's me!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I'm not saying it makes sense, because I don't really get it since I'm not particularly good-looking or talented or anything...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: No arguments from me... You're just... Plucky.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Exactly! I `am` her type! She likes plucky!
nodes.text_bbcode: Exactly! I [color=#e23b3b][i]am[/i][/color] her type! She likes plucky!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: And as long as she digs plucky, I'm staying!
Paige herds Elliana and the rest of the Wilson elites back outside.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: If we see your friends, we'll tell them you were looking for them.

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: That's okay. You don't have to tell them anything.

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: You `don't` want us to tell your friends you were looking for them?
nodes.text_bbcode: You [color=#3b78e2][i]don't[/i][/color] want us to tell your friends you were looking for them?

nodes.speaker: Steve
nodes.text: Ha! They're not really our friends!

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: Steve! Shut up!

nodes.speaker: Steve
nodes.text: Sorry...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I wish I could say it's been a pleasure...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Bye, y'all!
Alexei and the elites turn from the cabin...

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: They're two scrawny nerds, and they don't know our `big` secret...
nodes.text_bbcode: They're two scrawny nerds, and they don't know our [color=#e23b3b][i]big[/i][/color] secret...

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: They aren't going to be able to warn Center`bore` in time!
nodes.text_bbcode: They aren't going to be able to warn Center[color=#e23b3b][i]bore[/i][/color] in time!

nodes.speaker: Steve
nodes.text: You mean Twin...
Alexei glares at Steve...

nodes.speaker: Steve
nodes.text: Sorry...

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: As I was saying... Everything goes as planned...

nodes.speaker: Steve
nodes.text: You got it, Alexei!

nodes.speaker: Darren
nodes.text: Heh! This is going to be the best 4th of July of all time!
Paige slams the door behind them!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Hee! You guys did it! We fooled them!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Phew!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Good gracious! My stars! I think I might swoon!

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Erik, they're gone. You don't have to stay in character, you know?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: In character?

nodes.speaker: Madisenn
nodes.text: That was awesome, you guys! We should totally celebrate!

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Yeah, I guess you guys were pretty awesome. Especially...
Prissy turns to Erik...

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Er... Never mind.
Justin and Erik remove their makeup...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Yeah, thanks, girls!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: But did you hear Alexei?! We have to warn everyone!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Do any of you have phones we could borrow?

nodes.speaker: Madisenn
nodes.text: Sure. Take mine. But I don't know if you'll get much reception out here...

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Come with me, Erik! I need to talk to you about something privately.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Sure! I love a good private talk!
Prissy and Erik step into the adjoining room...
Meanwhile, Justin steps outside to try and call Angie...
At the 4th of July Bonfire at Centerscore Beach, Angie's phone rings... She picks it up...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Hello?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Angie? Hello? You guys are in danger!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Hello? Justin? Is that you?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Wilson is coming there with a gigantic catapult with paint!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Who has a cat?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Wilson! Wilson is going to attack!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Justin, I can't hear you! The connection's really bad. Why don't you come over here and share your friend's cat pictures?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Wilson is going to attack!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: I love cats! See you soon!
She hangs up.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Grrr! No!
Justin sighs.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: They're going to be caught completely by surprise! We've got to warn them!
Justin rushes back into the cabin, through the living room...
...And bursts into the adjoining room!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Erik, we need to...
Prissy and Erik are in each other's arms, kissing! Erik immediately jumps up!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Whoop! Good talk, Prissy!

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Uh, yeah! Stop being such a nerd! You're... Embarrassing!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Sorry to interrupt whatever's going on here...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: But we've gotta go, Erik!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Um... Could I have a private talk with you, Justin?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Uh, not if this is what a private talk is...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: A real private talk!

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: I'll just be... In the other room.
Prissy excuses herself...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: We need to go `now,` Erik.
nodes.text_bbcode: We need to go [color=#e23b3b][i]now,[/i][/color] Erik.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I'm not going.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: What? Erik, we have to warn everyone!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Go on without me. I... I want to stay.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I can't believe I'm hearing this! What about all your friends?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Justin, I'm... I'm never going to have this chance again...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: What are you talking about?!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I'm talking about how we're nothing. We're nobodies. Girls don't care about guys like us.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: And here we are, in this cabin with girls who are, forgive me for being forward, `really pretty...`
nodes.text_bbcode: And here we are, in this cabin with girls who are, forgive me for being forward, [color=#e23b3b][i]really pretty...[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Plus I'm picking up all kinds of girl signals from Prissy!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: ...Like her tongue in my mouth, for one...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I think she might want to get back together!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: You really think Prissy is into you? Prissy isn't into you, Erik...
Elliana returns to the group of Wilson elites...
Just as Paige is about to close the door, Alexei stops it with his foot...

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: Wait! Something isn't right!
In one quick motion, he barrels past Paige...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Hey!
Grabs Madisenn's soda...

nodes.speaker: Madisenn
nodes.text: That's mine!
And tosses it in Justin's face, smearing his makeup!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: `Ack!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Ack![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Whoa! The hot goth chicks! They're dudes!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Uh... My makeup's all smeared! Now I `look` like a guy!
nodes.text_bbcode: Uh... My makeup's all smeared! Now I [color=#e23b3b][i]look[/i][/color] like a guy!

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: Nice try! Get outside now, dweeb!
He looks at Erik...

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: You too, `'Erika.'`
nodes.text_bbcode: You too, [color=#e23b3b][i]'Erika.'[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: My word!
There, under the light of the full moon, the Wilson elites point their paintball guns at Justin and Erik.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: You're not very good at being a girl... You know that, right?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Yeah, well, it's not exactly natural to me. I'm sorry.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Not as sorry as you're going to be in about two seconds...

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: Ready... Aim... Fire!
The Wilson elites fire their paintball guns, coloring Justin and Erik with a display bright enough to rival any fireworks show!
This display is far from joyous... It's clear...
Justin has failed. Try again and see if you can help Justin pull off the gender switch!

nodes.speaker: Elliana
nodes.text: You're sure?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Uh, oh wait... Did you say jodh`purs?` I totally thought you said a different word.
nodes.text_bbcode: Uh, oh wait... Did you say jodh[color=#e23b3b][i]purs?[/i][/color] I totally thought you said a different word.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Jodhpurs are... Of course...
Erik surreptitiously makes the motion of a jockey, then swipes at his own leg...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Horse legs... Er... Horse pants! Riding pants!
Elliana eyes Justin suspiciously...
Elliana gives Justin a scrutinizing gaze...

nodes.speaker: Elliana
nodes.text: I am sorry. I doubted your authenticity. All the respect to you both.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Thank you...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: And to you, sugar!

nodes.text: You're sure?

nodes.text: You're sure?

nodes.text: Jodhpurs are... Of course...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Horse legs... Er... Horse pants! Riding pants!
Elliana eyes Justin suspiciously...
Alexei returns to the Wilson elites and huddles up with them...
A second later, Elliana steps forward.

nodes.speaker: Elliana
nodes.text: So...

nodes.speaker: Elliana
nodes.text: You two are this Paige's friends, no? From Alabama? You are rich girls, yes?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Oh, my sweet vapors, we've got all kinds of money!

nodes.speaker: Elliana
nodes.text: Then you must be very familiar with the goings-on of all things high-fashion.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Of course! I know all about camisoles, empire lines, and all things couture!

nodes.speaker: Elliana
nodes.text: Hmmm... What about you?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Uh... Who doesn't know what's hot? Camels, empires, all things crouton!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Hee hee hee! She's joking!

nodes.speaker: Elliana
nodes.text: Do you know what jodhpurs are?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Uh... Of course! Jodhpurs are...

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: `His` sister?
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]His[/i][/color] sister?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Er... I meant, 'I'm her brother's sister.'

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: That's a weird way of putting it...

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: Her `brother?`
nodes.text_bbcode: Her [color=#e23b3b][i]brother?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Er... I meant, 'I'm her brother's sister.'

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: That's a weird way of putting it...

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: `His brother?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]His brother?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Er... I meant, 'I'm her brother's sister.'

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: That's a weird way of putting it...

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: Really? You two are related?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Uh huh!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Of course!
Erik poses his face right next to Justin's!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Sisters since birth!
Steve steps in...

nodes.speaker: Steve
nodes.text: I can't believe you didn't see it sooner! They look totally alike!

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: I knew they were related! It's obvious!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: His... Er... Her... Brother... Sister!

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: What did you say?

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: Yeah... Who are these girls?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Uh... These are my... Um...
Erik adopts a perfectly high-pitched Southern accent.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Friends from the great state of Alabama! I'm Erik-a... Erika Swanson... How do you do?
Erik daintily extends a hand. Alexei takes it.

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: Nice to meet you...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: A pleasure.
Alexei turns to Justin...

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: What about you?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Oh, I'm...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: My, oh my! Well, aren't you just the scruffiest, cutest boy I've ever seen!

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: You really think so, huh?
Behind Skazz, Paige makes a `cut it out` gesture!
nodes.text_bbcode: Behind Skazz, Paige makes a [b]cut it out[/b] gesture!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Uh... Now I'm not so sure!

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Something feels weird, because girls `never` think I'm cute...
nodes.text_bbcode: Something feels weird, because girls [color=#e23b3b][i]never[/i][/color] think I'm cute...

nodes.text: Alexei steps into the cabin...
Justin slaps Skazz across the face!

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Hey!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Don't you `ever` disrespect me like that again!
nodes.text_bbcode: Don't you [color=#e23b3b][i]ever[/i][/color] disrespect me like that again!

nodes.text: Erik kicks Skazz in the shin!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Me neither!

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Ow! Sorry...
Skazz limps back to the other Wilson elites, rubbing his face.

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: The hotter they are, the harder they hit...
A knock thunders on the front door!

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: Hey! Anyone in there?! Open up!
Paige moves toward the door...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You will?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: We will?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Yeah, you could obviously use some help... Judging by the soda spilling.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Why would you `want` to be our servants?
nodes.text_bbcode: Why would you [color=#3b78e2][i]want[/i][/color] to be our servants?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Uhhhh...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: It's the 4th of July! What's more American than helping out people in need?!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Well... I can't argue against that...

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Uh, except... You're guys!

nodes.speaker: Caroline
nodes.text: My mother always says a guy who cleans is an angel in disguise!

nodes.speaker: Caroline
nodes.text: Or, someone who will steal your china when you're not looking. She's moody.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: We'll be completely out of your hair, I promise! You can throw us out as soon as we start to bother you.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Unlikely to happen! We've got a whole evening's worth of Paul Revere facts to...
Justin elbows Erik in the ribs.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Hrrp!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Sure... Why not? It's not like either of you nerds are a threat anyway...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I guess you can come in... But you'd better clean good!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Yes, ma'am!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: We will. We promise.
A few minutes later...
Justin and Erik are on their hands and knees, scrubbing a soda stain out of the carpet!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Eureka! I knew salt would get this right out! Plus a light, gentle scrub, of course!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Are you some kind of superhero cleaner, Erik?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: My sister Astrid is a coffee-thrower. I've dealt with stains you've only dreamed of!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Uhh... Right...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Ohmygosh! I don't think my dad's cabin has ever looked this nice! You guys are the best!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Thanks, but there's something we need to tell you...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Uh huh. Sure!

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Let me guess...

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: A team of ninja lawyers is trying to sue you for all your money...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: No, I'm telling the truth! We `are` in danger!
nodes.text_bbcode: No, I'm telling the truth! We [color=#e23b3b][i]are[/i][/color] in danger!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Sure you are...

nodes.speaker: Madisenn
nodes.text: My turn!

nodes.speaker: Madisenn
nodes.text: I bet you guys angered a family of honey badgers, and now you're being systematically hunted!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: That isn't it... I'm serious...

nodes.speaker: Caroline
nodes.text: Ooh! I want to play!

nodes.speaker: Caroline
nodes.text: What if they discovered a plot by Wilson High to attack Twin Branches with a catapult filled with paint?!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: What?! How did you...?!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Good night, boys! Next time you want to crash a slumber party, come up with a reason that isn't so totally played out!
Paige slams the door in their face!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Well, that was fun!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: We're in a lot of trouble! We just wasted a bunch of time! Wilson will be here any minute!
Somewhere nearby, a twig snaps!

nodes.speaker: Steve
nodes.text: Hey, Alexei! There's some kind of house over here!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Psst! Erik! This way!
Justin grabs Erik, and they crash into the cabin through the back door!

nodes.speaker: Madisenn
nodes.text: AHHHHHHHHH! Intruders!
Madisenn instinctively throws her soda on Justin and Erik!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Ick...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Gross... How many sodas do you have?!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What are you doing here? Didn't I just...?
Justin rises and cups his hand around Paige's mouth!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Mmf!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Shh! Listen!
Outside, the sounds of the Wilson High elites grow louder...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: It's Wilson High... They're after us!

nodes.speaker: Caroline
nodes.text: I was right! I was right! Squeeeee!
Erik softly covers her mouth...

nodes.speaker: Caroline
nodes.text: Mfffffff!
Justin and Erik are running through the woods when they come upon a cabin...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: A cabin in the woods?! Perfect! We're safe now!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Uh... Easy there, Erik... Let's not do anything...
Erik bounds over to the front door of the cabin!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: ...Hasty.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Sorry, Justin! We need asylum, and we need it fast! Wilson could show up at any minute!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Besides, maybe there are cute girls here!
Erik knocks on the cabin's front door...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Erik, are you insane?! Cute girls go to malls or the beach or college campuses...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: That's true...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Or they play role-playing games and date guys with reddish hair and a black earring!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: That's weirdly specific...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: The point is... You're not going to find `any` in a log cabin in the middle of the woods!
nodes.text_bbcode: The point is... You're not going to find [color=#e23b3b][i]any[/i][/color] in a log cabin in the middle of the woods!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: You're more likely to find a creepy guy with a scythe collection...
The door opens, revealing Paige, Prissy, and the girls of Monarch Prep!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: What.

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Erik?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Oh, hey there, Prissy! Didn't expect to find you here!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Although we were just talking about cute girls...
Behind Prissy, Madisenn trips, spilling her soda on the rug!

nodes.speaker: Madisenn
nodes.text: Great! Another mess to clean!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: What are you ladies doing here?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Hello? This is my dad's cabin! It's a slumber party, and we have a strict, no-guys policy, so...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: No worries... Not my first time getting kicked out of the rodeo...
Paige starts to close the door...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Wait!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Let us in... Please!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Did you `not` just hear me? Oh my gosh, this guy is completely deaf or something!
nodes.text_bbcode: Did you [color=#3b78e2][i]not[/i][/color] just hear me? Oh my gosh, this guy is completely deaf or something!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: We need you to let us in! We...

options.label: Are in a lot of danger!

nodes.text: Far away, out on the beach, he sees the students of Twin Branches...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Guys!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Justin! Hey, man! Get over here!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: The party is on, dude!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We're roasting marshmallows!
Behind them, the Splat-A-Pult silently drifts through the water, manned by Steph from Wilson High!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Oh no! I'm too late!
Justin sprints toward them!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Guys! Guys! Look out!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Wow, Justin really wants a marshmallow.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: He's weird like that.
Steph aims the Splat-A-Pult, releases a lever, and sends a gigantic orb of paint high into the air...
Justin stops in his tracks!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: `No!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]No![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Wait... I guess he doesn't want a marshmallow...
The orb crashes down on the students, sending them sprawling!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: `AAAAHHHH!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]AAAAHHHH![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: `OOF!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]OOF![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: `UHF!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]UHF![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Another orb arcs through the sky and splatters over the cheerleaders, drenching them in a bright array of colored paint!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: `NOOO!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]NOOO![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: `EWWW!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]EWWW![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: `Yay! I'm a rainbow!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Yay! I'm a rainbow![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Another one hits the nerds...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: `Accck!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Accck![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: We don't have any Protection from Paint gear!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: 4th of July is ruined!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Angie... No...
Soon, the students flee from the beach, past Justin, and into the parking lot...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: No! Wait! It's a trap!
But now no one will listen. He was too late to warn them of the Splat-A-Pult...
And now, it's too late to warn them of the Wilson elites waiting for them in the parking lot!

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: Payback time, suckers!
He closes his eyes and buries his head in his hands... Unable to drown out the sound of the students' cries...
Or the feeling of tremendous guilt welling up inside him...
Well, you might have figured it out, but this was definitely `not` the ending Justin wanted!
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, you might have figured it out, but this was definitely [b]not[/b] the ending Justin wanted!

nodes.text: Try again and see if you can get to the beach in time to warn the students before Wilson High strikes!

args.text: Surviving High School
Thanks for playing!

nodes.text: Justin sees the different cliques of Twin Branches, all hanging out near a large bonfire...
The popular kids...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What else can we throw on this fire?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: You mean besides these perfect hot dogs?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Or these fluffy marshmallows?
The swim team...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I'd love to go out for a swim...

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Yeah, and freeze to death!
The rebels...

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: What are we doing here?

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: I don't know... Girls, bikinis, fire! Seems cool to me!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: If we get really bored, I brought the water cannon from last year!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Seriously?
Kenji nods at a large object hidden under a tarp in the back of his truck.

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: This just got a lot more interesting...
Justin runs up to Angie, who's hanging out with the nerds...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Justin, what's wrong? You look like you've seen a ghost?!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I'm not too late... I have to warn you...
Justin raises his voice so everyone can hear...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Wilson is coming! They've got a catapult that fires paint! They're coming for revenge!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Are you sure?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I saw it with my own eyes. They'll be here any second!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Well, we'll be waiting...
A few minutes later, Twin Branches students are posted at every entrance to the parking lot above the beach...
Behind the main entrance, the rebels point the massive barrel of the water cannon...
Howard pats Justin on the back!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Good job, man. When they get here, they're in for the shock of their lives!
A few minutes pass...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Don't worry, everyone! They'll be here!
A few more minutes... The students begin to grow impatient...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Where are they?!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Just, you know, be patient...
Ten minutes later...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Okay, is this some kind of weird Justin prank? 'Cause they're not coming, man!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I swear, it's not a prank! They'll be here!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Yeah, well, you can man the gate, then!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: `I'm` going to go get my party on!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]I'm[/i][/color] going to go get my party on!

nodes.text: Hector runs down to the bonfire! Soon, everyone follows...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Sorry, Justin... It looks like you were wrong...
Then, over Howard's shoulder, far away on a point jutting out into the water, Justin sees Erik, riding a horse along the shore and waving the two glowsticks from the gift bag!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: What the...
Howard turns.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Is that Erik? On a horse?!
Realization sweeps over Justin like a cascade of water!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Two if by sea!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Two glowsticks! Two lanterns! Wilson isn't coming by land! They're coming by sea!
Justin points out to the water, where the Splat-A-Pult can be seen on a boat drifting silently toward the beach...
Manning the craft are the Wilson elites!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Come on!
Justin and Howard run down and warn everyone!
A minute later, the water cannon is pointed out to sea!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: And... Fire!
The cannon blasts a rushing force of water out to sea, shattering the catapult, and spilling paint all over the Wilson elites!

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: `Uck!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Uck![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Darren
nodes.text: `Grr!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Grr![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Elliana
nodes.text: `Ew!` Only my hair is supposed to be blue!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Ew![/i][/color] Only my hair is supposed to be blue!

nodes.speaker: Steve
nodes.text: This wasn't the plan, was it?
Before the cannon fires another shot, Wilson retreats!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: We did it!
The students let out a cheer!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Who wants to celebrate and shoot off some fireworks?!
As the students rally around Howard and his fireworks, Erik runs past Justin!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Fireworks! Come on, buddy!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Uh... No, thanks, Erik.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Tonight was `awesome,` wasn't it?!
nodes.text_bbcode: Tonight was [color=#e23b3b][i]awesome,[/i][/color] wasn't it?!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: You really came through... What made you decide to come back? And how'd you know Wilson was coming from the ocean?
Erik pats Justin on the shoulder...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Ho, boy, what a story! I'll tell you later...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: But right now, it's fireworks time!
Erik scampers off toward the fireworks...
Justin walks along the beach, a lonely look on his face...
Angie walks beside him...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Hey, Justin...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Hi, Angie. Where's $Scott? I figured this kind of party would be his thing.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: He had to pick up some equipment for his backpacking trip...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Oh... Right. I'm sorry about you two. I heard about how you're going to break up at the end of summer...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Must be hard.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: It hasn't been my favorite time of year.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Anyway, you're kind of the hero, today, aren't you?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I guess... Heh.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: What's funny?
Justin stops, looking out at the dark ocean.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I thought that I wanted to be the hero. That if I did something like this as my last Presidential act, everyone would be my friend.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Well, there's your opportunity...
Angie nods to the cool kids, who are off playing with fireworks, calling and waving for Justin to join them.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I know, but, uh, I was wrong. That isn't what I want.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: It isn't? What do you want?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: You.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Excuse me?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I want you, Angie.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Justin, I'm with...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I know, just... Just let me finish.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I want you, but I'm not asking anything of you. You're with $Scott... And I know that...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: But I see everyone graduating, and I know that there isn't much time left... I can't be passive anymore.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: So... There, I said it. I like you, and you're beautiful, and I understand if you don't want talk to me ever again. Goodbye.
Justin walks off...

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Justin! Wait!
Angie runs over to him and kisses him lightly on the cheek.

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: Never thought I'd do that.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: What was that for?

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: For being brave.
He smiles...
Wow! You helped Justin warn Twin Branches in time, and as a result, he helped repel the Wilson attack!
Even more, you helped him express his feelings for Angie...
What that will mean only time will tell... For now...
`Congratulations! You played a great game!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [b]Congratulations! You played a great game![/b]

args.text: Surviving High School
Thanks for playing!

nodes.text: Justin pedals with all his energy, his feet like pistons of continuous energy!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Grr!
Soon there's separation between his bike and Darren's car!

nodes.speaker: Darren
nodes.text: Hey!
Erik appears on Justin's right side, pedaling just as hard!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Justin! I'm not cut out for this kind of sweaty adventure! I think we're going to have to...
But Stiletto's car knifes between them, separating Justin and Erik!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Whoa!

nodes.speaker: Stiletto
nodes.text: Sorry to interrupt the party!
Stiletto banks her car left toward Justin! He veers left...
And almost crashes into Elliana's car!

nodes.speaker: Elliana
nodes.text: Don't you dare scratch me, American nerd!
Both cars are parallel to Justin, closing the space between each other, sandwiching him!
Stiletto smiles as she pulls out a paintball gun and points it at Justin!

nodes.speaker: Stiletto
nodes.text: Night, night.
Elliana whips out a gun of her own, aiming it out her passenger side window!

nodes.speaker: Elliana
nodes.text: Sweet dreams!
Score Up!
Justin slams on the brakes just as both girls fire their guns!
Their paintballs splatter all over each other's clothes, cars, and faces!

nodes.speaker: Stiletto
nodes.text: My car! My perfect car!

nodes.speaker: Elliana
nodes.text: My face! My perfect face!
Meanwhile, Justin turns down a side street, and Erik rides up behind him...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Nice steering, buddy!
But Darren and Skazz's cars hug the turn and accelerate right behind Erik!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: `AHH!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]AHH![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Darren
nodes.text: What are you riding away for?!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I'm not going to make it! I'm not going to make it!

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: We just want to be friends!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Hiccup! Hiccup! Hiccup!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Keep pedaling, Erik!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Cars always beat bikes, Justin! I'm statistically done for!
Steve leans out the window of Skazz's car and fires a round of paintballs at Erik's back!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Ow! Ow! Ow!

nodes.speaker: Steve
nodes.text: Heh. New favorite sport! Nerd hunting!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Leave him alone, you butt ugly jerk!
Steve fires another pellet, this one causing Erik's tire to explode!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Whooooooa! Wobbly time!
Darren's car comes forward, this time rubbing the exposed frame of Erik's back wheel! Sparks fly everywhere!

nodes.speaker: Darren
nodes.text: Ha! Check it out! Fireworks!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: You son of a...
Justin slows down so that he's right in front of Erik's bike!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Erik, jump!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I don't think so!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: You have to jump!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I'm pretty sure I could also `not` jump!
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm pretty sure I could also [color=#e23b3b][i]not[/i][/color] jump!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I'll catch you!
Another blast of sparks shoots off of Erik's back wheel!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: On second thought...
Erik leaps from his bike!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Woooop!
Justin and Erik pedal furiously out of the lot!
Several Wilson cars peel out behind them, slamming onto the street right behind Justin and Erik!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Cripes!
Justin pedals furiously, stealing glances back over his shoulder...
From the pack of cars, Darren's surges out, the engine roaring!
Skazz walks right into the cabin, pushing past Paige and Prissy...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Hey!

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Watch it!
And stops right in front of Justin and Erik!

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Why haven't you introduced these girls?! They look so... So... Familiar and...

nodes.speaker: Skazz
nodes.text: Hot!
Justin and Erik are running through the woods when they come upon a cabin...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: A cabin in the woods?! Perfect! We're safe now!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Uh... Easy there, Erik... Let's not do anything...
Erik bounds over to the front door of the cabin!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: ...Hasty.

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Sorry, Justin! We need asylum, and we need it fast! Wilson could show up at any minute!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Besides, maybe there are cute girls here!
Erik knocks on the cabin's front door...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Erik, are you insane?! Cute girls go to malls or the beach or college campuses...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: That's true...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Or they play role-playing games and date guys with reddish hair and a black earring!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: That's weirdly specific...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: The point is... You're not going to find `any` in a log cabin in the middle of the woods!
nodes.text_bbcode: The point is... You're not going to find [color=#e23b3b][i]any[/i][/color] in a log cabin in the middle of the woods!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: You're more likely to find a creepy guy with a scythe collection...
The door opens, revealing Paige, Prissy, and the girls of Monarch Prep!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: What.

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Erik?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Oh, hey there, Prissy! Didn't expect to find you here!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Although we were just talking about cute girls...
Behind Prissy, Madisenn trips, spilling her soda on the rug!

nodes.speaker: Madisenn
nodes.text: Great! Another mess to clean!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: What are you ladies doing here?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Hello? This is my dad's cabin! It's a slumber party, and we have a strict, no-guys policy, so...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: No worries... Not my first time getting kicked out of the rodeo...
Paige starts to close the door...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Wait!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Let us in... Please!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Did you `not` just hear me? Oh my gosh, this guy is completely deaf or something!
nodes.text_bbcode: Did you [color=#3b78e2][i]not[/i][/color] just hear me? Oh my gosh, this guy is completely deaf or something!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: We need you to let us in! We...

options.label: Are in a lot of danger!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Please... Will you help us?!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Of course... We hate Wilson just as much as you guys do!

nodes.speaker: Madisenn
nodes.text: They're always calling `us` spoiled, rich girls! As if!
nodes.text_bbcode: They're always calling [color=#3b78e2][i]us[/i][/color] spoiled, rich girls! As if!

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Yeah, the next time I hear that, I swear, I'm going to have one of my dad's servants punch them in the face!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Hey! Focus! Wilson problem!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Right... It's not a big deal. We'll just tell them we haven't seen you guys!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Yeah, but you're a bunch of cute girls. Alexei will try to get in.

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: We have a strict no-guys policy!
Justin gives the girls a look...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Well, it's not a hard and fast rule!
Alexei pounds on the door again!

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: Open up! I know someone's in there! I hear voices!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: We could hide!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: This cabin is too small for that. Alexei will find us in a heartbeat!
Justin notices the girls' spare clothing draped over the back of the couch...
An idea starts to form...
He looks at the gift bag in his hand and thinks about the white makeup...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I know what we have to do! Quick! Erik, strip down!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Excuse me?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Yeah, I don't know if these girls can handle the raw Ericson in his skivvies!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Just do it!
A quick, embarrassing moment later...
Justin and Erik are both wearing dresses and their faces are covered in white makeup!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: How do we look?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I think I kind of look like Dinah!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Actually... Both of you are kind of attractive. You know, for goths.

nodes.speaker: Madisenn
nodes.text: Yeah, if you squint...

nodes.speaker: Caroline
nodes.text: Or close your eyes completely! So cute!

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I don't know how to take that...

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: You guys, er... Girls, ready?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Let's do this!
Paige opens the door...
And the Wilson elites are standing there, seething mad!

nodes.speaker: Alexei
nodes.text: What took you so long?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Uh... Rude! We're having a slumber party, so go away!
Paige tries to slam the door closed but Elliana blocks it with her shoe!

nodes.speaker: Elliana
nodes.text: Maybe you have seen our... Friends. They are two insignificant, American nerd boys. We need them for... A team project.

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: We haven't seen anyone like that.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Yeah, and all of you smell like gasoline, so...
Paige tries to close the door, but Skazz pushes it open!

nodes.speaker: Skazz

nodes.text: The 4th of July...
Justin walks into Principal Shapiro's office. Shapiro is standing at the window, looking out. She sighs.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Principal? You okay?

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: I'm in school on July 4th when I could be poolside at a BBQ with my...

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: ...Uh, friend.

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: So, no. It's not my best day.
Shapiro sits at her desk and motions for Justin to take the seat across from her.

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: What about you?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: It's definitely weird to be here during the summer. At least the new school facilities have state-of-the-art air conditioning...

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: True, but that doesn't answer my question... How are you?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Me? Fine! Fine! Everything's fine!
Shapiro raises an eyebrow.

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: I've come to know you pretty well during your term as President, Justin...

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: I can tell when you're lying...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Okay, okay, you caught me...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: I'm just... I'm disappointed that I'm not going to be President next year, that's all. It's sort of become my identity. My thing.

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: I'm sorry that you didn't win, Justin. However, if your Presidency is any indication of who you are, then I'm confident you'll find a new `thing` next year...
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm sorry that you didn't win, Justin. However, if your Presidency is any indication of who you are, then I'm confident you'll find a new [color=#3b78e2][i]thing[/i][/color] next year...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Thanks... But if it's all the same to you, I really don't want to talk about this. Can we just move on to the reason you called me in?

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: Sure...
Shapiro folds a letter and inserts it into an envelope...

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: You probably found out about the prank that got pulled at Wilson High during their graduation ceremony...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Yes, despicable. Some of our idiots flooded their ceremony with baby lizards. I've never been more embarrassed to represent Twin Branches.

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: Oh, lighten up, Justin! I found it amusing. School rivalries can spice things up from time to time.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Well, I did hear that Alexei had so many lizards crawling on him he was practically a terrarium...

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: Ha!

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: Nevertheless, Principal Dunkirk is furious.

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: I would be too if some of his students had ruined our graduation with a bunch of wild badgers...

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: Anyway, he agreed to dissuade his students from retaliating, but knowing him, it won't happen without a formal apology and a gift bag...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: A gift bag?

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: Don't ask. It's a Principal thing.

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Riiiiight. So... Where do I come in?

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: As my messenger. Take this letter and this gift bag and deliver them to Dunkirk. If you don't get over there quickly, I'm certain that Wilson `will` retaliate!
nodes.text_bbcode: As my messenger. Take this letter and this gift bag and deliver them to Dunkirk. If you don't get over there quickly, I'm certain that Wilson [color=#3b78e2][i]will[/i][/color] retaliate!

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: I don't want this escalating. I don't want anyone getting hurt. Do you understand me?

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Yes, ma'am.

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: On another note... After this, I probably won't be needing your services for the remainder of the school year...

nodes.speaker: Justin
nodes.text: Wait... So, this will be my final act as President? Delivering a letter of apology and a gift bag to Wilson High?!

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: Do you have a problem with your assignment?
